title: The Sacred Creature's Test
intro: A sign was sent to a nation that had gone astray. In the midst of their comfortable lives came a warning—accompanied by a remarkable creature that would become the ultimate test of their faith. Their response would seal their fate forever. Can you uncover who delivered this warning and what became of those who rejected it?
clues: We were a people who had been guided by previous messengers before us.
A magnificent creature emerged from the mountain, a sign from our Lord for this nation.
I told them: 'This is a she-camel belonging to Allah, so leave her to eat from Allah's earth and do not touch her with harm.'
But the people hamstrung my she-camel, defying the command of their Lord.
I am only a messenger from your Lord, sent with the truth—I am a trustworthy prophet and servant.
As for the wrongdoers, our Lord struck them with a thunderous sound, and they became motionless in their homes.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: Prophet Hud of the people of A'ad
Prophet Salih of the people of Thamud
Prophet Shu'aib of Midian
Prophet Lut of the people of Sodom
Prophet Nuh of the Ark
identity.answer: Prophet Salih of the people of Thamud

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: The Flood that drowned a disbelieving nation
The earthquake that destroyed a sinful city
The she-camel sent as a divine sign and test
The storm that punished the people of Midian
The destruction of the people of Lot with stones
trial.answer: The she-camel sent as a divine sign and test

location.label: Key Element
options: The city of Sodom in the Jordan Valley
The valley of Al-Hijr between Hijaz and Syria
The ancient land of A'ad in southern Arabia
The forests of Midian near the Red Sea
The plains of Mount Judi in Mesopotamia
location.answer: The valley of Al-Hijr between Hijaz and Syria

outcome.label: Outcome
options: They were saved after repenting and believing
A rain of stones destroyed them completely
A thunderous sound struck them motionless
They were carried away by a violent wind
An earthquake swallowed them into the ground
outcome.answer: A thunderous sound struck them motionless

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verse: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen. (54:31)
